context: Riku takes Sho to Saito's clinic for a small follow-up. Riku as caring older cousin.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: リクさんが、しょうくんを、連れてきてくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so glad Riku-san brought Sho-kun in to see me.
lines.style: Warm, genuine smile in the voice. Soft opening on the gratitude. Professional but unhurried — the care is audible, not performed. Steady, steady eye-contact level throughout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんも、お母さんも、忙しくて。
lines.en: My parents have been really busy.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact explanation. No edge to it — just stating the reality he's accepted. Slight downward drift at the end, like he's moved past it already.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: リクお兄ちゃん、優しい。
lines.style: Small, genuine voice. Wonder in it — not performing amazement, just noticing something true. The kind of sincere observation only a six-year-old can make without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: しょうくん、元気そうで、安心です。
lines.style: Professional warmth with real substance behind it. Light landing on 'well' — she's genuinely relieved. Measured close, like she's moving to the next thing but the care lingers.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、先生。
lines.style: Respectful but unguarded. A slight lift at the close — gratitude without flattering. Polite formality that comes from actual respect, not performance.
